programme.title: 月老
programme.desc: 劇情描述遭雷擊的阿綸（柯震東 飾）來到陰間，生前所有的記憶歸零他必須做出選擇：投胎轉世或是擔任神職？阿綸決定成為月老新鮮人，他與個性爆衝粉紅女Pinky（王淨 飾）搭檔，來到人間執行任務，當阿綸遇見狗狗阿魯以及主人小咪時，他前世的記憶都回來了，小咪（宋芸樺 飾）就是他生前的摯愛

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: 香港版麻雀變鳳凰，由劉德華扮演厭惡上流社會的富家公子，張敏是窮人家女兒，個性率直單純陰錯陽差下，張敏將劉德華誤認為偷渡客，而展開一段好笑又浪漫的愛情故事

programme.title: 遺產風暴
programme.desc: 為了繼承父親20億的遺產，家族成員們齊聚一堂就在大家對於遺產分配金額僵持不下之際，長男突然接到綁匪的電話，要他準備好贖金20億韓元，不然就要殺了他的孩子

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:258
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:258
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:262
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 新暫時停止呼吸
programme.desc: 靈幻道士英叔（林正英）的舊情人蓮妹，託其妹念英求援，師徒來到大帥府，見大帥身染屍毒，而身懷六甲的蓮，體中胎兒非常怪異，英發覺其褓姆並非常人，於是想引魔胎離開母體，加以消滅，但褓姆拼死護胎，英進退兩難之際，廣西殭屍群跟蹤而來，令眾人腹背受敵，一場殭屍魔胎的大戰就此展開...

programme.title: 三國殺．幻
programme.desc: 羅文與好友曹晨共同經營著一個車行，妻子王術是文物局研究員，他們的生活平靜幸福正當兩人準備迎接一個新生命的到來時，兩撥神祕人同時出現在車行，一番激戰過後，車行爆炸

programme.title: 逃學威龍3之龍過雞年
programme.desc: 城中富豪王百萬（周星馳分飾）遇害警方找來面貌與王百萬十分相似的周星星（周星馳飾）出任臥底追查本來周星星曾答應過何老師（張敏飾）不再當臥底，但上頭軍令如山，反對無效

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: 劇情講述日本九菊一派販毒集團和香港警察鬥智鬥力的故事

programme.title: 好賭英雄
programme.desc: 無賭不精的陳百祥邂逅千金小姐高麗紅，幾經波折追求到手，為討伊人芳心更金盤洗手，斬斷賭根，可是偏偏碰上岳父是個退休賭王，兩個高手碰頭，當然要來個決勝賭局

programme.title: 賭城風雲2

programme.desc: 這年夏天，富家女葉紛紛（舒淇 飾）因逃避家人催婚，帶著媽媽留下的外婆的澎湖灣錄音帶，一路找到澎湖，打算體驗網路上形容的無敵海景民宿與歌裡的風情不料迎接她的民宿主人阿武（任賢齊 飾）卻是個魯莽的打漁人！年少跑船，因母親早逝，返家協助父親（狄龍 飾）照顧弟弟（李國毅 飾），開了民宿弟弟投資被騙，民宿將遭查封，阿武不得不扛起重擔償還高額利息，朋友們為了幫阿武拓展生意，在網路上做了誇張的宣傳，不料竟騙?了葉紛紛！面對現實中簡陋的民宿她氣急敗壞，槓上阿武而不久之後，即將落貼的法院封條與紛紛親人的來訪，即將引爆一場搶救大作戰

programme.title: 超級學校霸王

programme.title: 雲南蟲谷
programme.desc: 胡八一等人由於之前探險而身上出現會帶來詛咒的印記，據說放在古滇國獻王陵墓中的?塵珠能解開詛咒，胡八一等人只好深入瘴癘之地眾人穿過古滇國秘密地下水道，不料遭遇千年痋術機關，成千上萬個痋俑倒懸在洞頂；深入叢林，更是不斷遭遇重重考驗終於，歷經兇險來到獻王墓入口，然而更大的挑戰也接踵而至

programme.title: 賭神

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 東坡家事:28
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.title: 翻生武林:1
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:13
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 翻生武林:2
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: Classical Theatre
programme.desc: This broad selection of drama series genres includes romance, military and family connections, captured in Chinas great classics.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This drama captures the legend of a young boxer who battles the odds to become the ultimate fighter in a tournament against his greatest rivals.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: This 1972 cult classic stars Lily Ho in her most audacious role as a mysterious courtesan caught in a web of sex and murder with her powerful madam.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Following the lives of three downtrodden, but resilient outcasts, John Lo Mars gritty social drama paints a sense of realism rarely seen in Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: After the emperors seal is stolen, The Rat and The Cats squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: This wuxia films swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Starring teenage heartthrob Pat Ting Hung, this film marks the directing debut of the kung-fu film genres most respected figure, Chang Cheh.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Two women and a man have to deal with forgery, fire and poisoned needles when they go up against a notorious gang.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: Dubbed Little Bastard due to never having known his parents, a young man seeks his roots, with help from a staunch ally called Little Beggar.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960s musical romances.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents his epic vision of the Temple, featuring his favourite leads Ti Lung, David Chiang and Alexander Fu Sheng.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers quintessential Huangmei Opera costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: Lets Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his fathers business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Screen idol Derek Yee is the ambitious Meteor master who becomes obsessed with sword supremacy and goes on a selfish rampage of violence and sex.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner Peter Chen Ho has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: This hard-hitting drama is based on a real-life investigation on the involvement of both cops as well as crooks in second offences.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowagers use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Martial arts maestro Lo Wei wrote, directed and co-starred in this tale of greed and lust for financial gain that depicts a family brought to its knees.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Catch this rare gem, a product of Hong Kong-style science fiction, complete with out-of-this-world visual effects.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the mans fiance.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Changan, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their fathers drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Ready or Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the next step.?

programme.title: The Dumpling Queen
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters after a failed marriage. She builds a dumpling stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises to become the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his fathers death, he enlists his fathers always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: LEIO
programme.desc: An ex-singer returns to his hometown takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken town, only to discover a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground!

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghais most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimers disease.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Love for All Seasons
programme.desc: Womanizer Tiger Hung arrives in Mount Emei to get the cure of his illness. May is the only woman who is capable to do so, but Tiger has to break her heart first before she gains the healing power.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: The Art Beat II Ep08
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived.

programme.desc: Prestige Chinese documentary production, tackling serious subjects with the best cinematography, editing, and all round production values with a unique Chinese perspective.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.title: 太平年 Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷钱弘俶赵匡胤郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱秩序崩溃生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，纳土归宋，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ag

programme.title: 天知道 Fates Secret
programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人感化世间暴戾的感人故事剧情强调善的力量与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人充满信念的作品Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Mia terharu apabila Maza sanggup datang sebagai pembelanya. Daus terpaksa menerima jahitan di keningnya akibat dari pergaduhan dengan Maza. Daus mahu membuat laporan polis tetapi Lyssa tidak membenarkan kerana dia tidak mahu disabitkan sekali nanti. Mak Ani jatuh sakit kerana tertekan dengan apa yang berlaku pada Mia. Mia pulang ke kampung tanpa memberitahu Daus. Puas Daus mencari Mia sehinggalah Mia menghantar pesanan kepada Lyssa yang dia berada di kampung. Daus terus pulang ke kampung dan pergi ke hospital. Melihat Mia ada bersama Ustazah Iman juga membuatkan Daus cemburu. Dia bencikan Mia tetapi tanpa dia sedar cintanya tidak pernah hilang terhadap isterinya itu.

programme.title: Biografi Agung
programme.desc: Kisah-kisah para insan mulia yang Allah SWT hadirkan untuk menemani Rasulullah SAW sepanjang perjuangan hidup baginda antaranya Abu Zal Al- Ghifari RA yang dihoskan oleh Ustaz Rozi Harun.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Si Luncai

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhats On Today
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026

The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the Critical Care Unit, searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2
programme.desc: In this 10-episode journey across South America, Christy explores three iconic destinationsPeru, Bolivia, and Brazilcombining extreme adrenaline challenges, local culture, and high-energy sightseeing

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Shock Mystery Sr.2
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of Shock Mystery has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by peopleunless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chuns surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Song Of Spring
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Cat vs Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Jada
programme.desc: Jada, a rising football star, abandons his ambitions to join a violent local tournament and avenge the death of his hero, Sethu.

A Top 10 staple, the Polish veteran Gamrot collected a second-round submission win over Esteban Ribovics earlier this year and holds additional victories over former champ Rafael Dos Anjos, Rafael Fiziev, and Arman Tsarukyan. Salkilld has rocketed into the rankings after graduating from Season 8 of Dana Whites Contender Series, posting five straight wins capped by a first-round finish of Beneil Dariush at home in Perth back in May.

programme.desc: 미국 코미디의 제왕 짐 캐리가 펼치는 인생역전 프로젝트. 모든 일에 quotYES!quot로 대답하게 된 한 남자에게 찾아온 행운과 특별한 사건들을 유쾌한 시선으로 그려낸 코미디물

programme.title: 가려진 시간
programme.desc: 의문의 실종사건 후, 시공간이 멈춘 세계에 갇혀 홀로 어른이 되어 돌아온 성민과 그의 말을 믿어준 단 한 소녀 수린의 감성 판타지

programme.title: 굿 윌 헌팅
programme.desc: 이 영화의 시나리오는 50페이지 분량에 불과한 단편소설에서 출발했고, 단편소설을 쓴 사람은 다름아닌 윌 헌팅의 배역으로 열연한 맷 데이먼.1998년 제70회 아카데미상 후보선정에 최우수 작품상, 남우주연상 등 9개 부문에 노미네이트되었고, 그해 골든글로브 상에서는 최우수 각본상을 수상했다.맷 데이먼과 벤 애플렉이 할리우드에 입성하게 된 계기가 된 영화.

programme.title: 스위치
programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
